stages.notes: Test replacing CLM5-BGC-Crop prognostic carbon-nitrogen crop canopy (LUH2) with CLM5-SP prescribed MODIS Satellite Phenology (dMAE) to save ~65% of canopy/BGC compute; improves eastern humid basins (HUC02/03/05) but degrades western snowmelt/arid ET partitioning.

Replace CLM5 LUH2 default canopy/snow/ET (f_wet=0.05, d_max=15mm) with ELMv3 Demeter transient crop LULCC (20261020_ELMv3...demeter.lulcc) and LHS-1500 calibrated maximum leaf-wetted fraction (f_wet), snowmelt factor (n_melt_coef), and dry-surface soil resistance.

Test raw uncalibrated ELMv3-BGC-Crop surface infiltration (20260831 default clm_params_c251006.nc where QOVER + QH2OSFC is +35% higher than CLM5); expected to trigger low-flow / moderate-flow volume bias guardrail veto. | VETOED: threshold failed on 'low_flow_pbias' (39.9607 vs 25.0); secondary degradation on 'low_flow_pbias' (17.9438 > 15.0)

Replace default TOPMODEL saturation-excess decay factor (fover=0.5 m^-1) with ELMv3 modified frozen-soil infiltration (run_default_modified_infil_True) and LHS-1500 basin-cluster calibrated fover and porosity scaling (watsat_sf) fit on 1981-1999.

Replace CLM5 unclipped linear baseflow drainage (which produces 124 negative QDRAI cell-months down to -9.06e-8 mm/s in I-25) with ELMv3 non-negative perched + unconfined aquifer drainage (QDRAI + QDRAI_PERCH >= 0) calibrated via LHS-1500 (K_bf, N_bf, S_y, hksat_sf, bsw_sf).

Attempt to replace the 120 node-hr 20-layer Richards vadose solver with an unconstrained neural regressor trained on peak hydrographs; tests whether Autoengineering's physical check vetoes negative drought baseflow (-2.4 m3/s) despite higher aggregate KGE. | VETOED: physical check 'nonnegative_runoff_and_baseflow' failed (Port 'qdrai_subsurface_m3s' minimum -573.851 >= -0.05); physical check 'nonnegative_terminal_discharge' failed (Port 'discharge_m3s' minimum -89.2587 >= -0); threshold failed on 'kge' (-0.1503 vs 0.6); threshold failed on 'nse' (-1.9266 vs 0.4); threshold failed on 'pbias' (-24.8669 vs 20.0); threshold failed on 'low_flow_pbias' (-205.1809 vs 25.0); secondary degradation on 'low_flow_pbias' (184.6528 > 15.0)

Replace Tethys 2.1.0 irrigation downscaler (which ignored canal loss and double-subtracted groundwater shares) with Tethys 2.2.0 (commit 2683048): enables irrigation_conveyance_efficiency = 0.829937 (1.2049x withdrawal scaling, I-07/I-10), pre-normalized crop weights (I-31), populated 6-year share interpolation (fixing zero-valued 1980/1985/1995/2000 years, I-11), and USGS Method 2 empirical HUC2 surface/groundwater partitioning (I-13).

Replace static thermoelectric & industrial downscaling with rebuilt 0-LMP CERF power-plant cooling-technology siting (once-through vs recirculating cooling return-flow ratios, I-08/I-09) and degree-day seasonal electricity dispatch.

Replace static 1990 population municipal downscaling with transient decadal urban population weights aligned with ELMv3 do_transient_urban=.true. and temperature-modulated summer outdoor municipal consumption.

Repair the 987 land cells with NaN hillslope slope (hslp) and 703 land cells with NaN channel slope (rslp) in mosart_conus_nldas_grid.nc (Issue I-23) using minimum slope floor (1e-4) and calibrated sub-network tributary roughness (nt), eliminating storage stalls in low-relief basins.

Replace pure 0.125-deg gridded main-channel outlet extraction across all basin sizes with sub-grid drainage-area reconciliation (IM3 Hybrid selector: exact catchment-area runoff aggregation for headwater basins <= 4 cells where 0.125-deg grid quantization causes >20% area distortion, coupled with mosartwmpy release/1.0.0 a69c2a7 #129 aggregation fix, I-01).

Replace 20230629 Biemans/Hanasaki reservoir parameters (where release_min is negative in 1,847 of 1,863 reservoirs, I-22) and gross withdrawal extraction with Broman-corrected 9505v4 reservoir storage/release rule curves, non-negative environmental release floor, coordinate-aligned 6-year reservoir demand reference (I-17), wmpy_irrigation_first_mask (I-21), and explicit return-flow routing (return_flow_enabled: true, I-20).
